long_biography.plain_text:
Lone Star Steakhouse & Saloon turned a small restaurant concept into a national casual-dining business, with Jamie Bennett Coulter serving as chairman and chief executive. His operating foundation came from Pizza Hut, where he developed and ran a large franchise network. He later built Coulter Enterprises into a vehicle for restaurant services and private investment, while also founding the energy business Sunburst Exploration.

After Lone Star was sold, Coulter continued allocating capital across consumer and energy businesses. Through Drink House Holdings, he joined restaurant entrepreneur Jimmy John Liautaud in acquiring a majority interest in 7 Brew and preparing the drive-through coffee company for franchising. Coulter remained chairman and chief executive of Coulter Enterprises until his death in 2022.
